Use for CH table questions, DESCRIBE TABLE, schema and source-of-truth checks under db/click_house, ingestion debugging, and investigating aggregates, distributions, outliers, or anomalous ClickHouse data in a GitLab GDK environment.

skills.name: gitlab-pipeline-watch

skills.name: gitlab-psql

skills.name: glab

skills.name: mr-review
skills.description: Review a GitLab merge request - read diffs, analyze changes, present findings, and optionally post comments on the MR

skills.name: opencode-refine

skills.name: playwright-cli
skills.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

skills.name: pushify
skills.description: Run pre-push lefthook checks and iteratively fix failures (up to 3 iterations, then escalate). Invoke when: (a) about to push and wanting hooks to pass cleanly, (b) `git push` has just failed on a pre-push hook and the failure needs to be driven to resolution, or (c) preparing a clean working tree without pushing — e.g. before opening a Draft MR for early review.

skills.name: run-in-tmux-pane
skills.description: Run commands in a temporary tmux pane with full interactive zsh environment (login shell, shims, PATH, aliases, TTY).

skills.name: self-service-performance-testing
skills.description: Help engineers write performance tests that detect regressions, using k6 for load testing and sitespeed.io for frontend Core Web Vitals. Use when the user is adding or changing API endpoints, database queries, critical paths, or frontend pages and needs to decide whether to write a performance test, what kind, or how to integrate it into CI. Also activate when the user mentions load testing, stress testing, response times, benchmarking, performance budgets, CPT, component performance testing, MR pipeline performance testing, or wants to run tests against staging - this skill enforces shared infrastructure safety rules. Does not cover profiling, APM, or debugging production incidents.

skills.name: stack-changes
skills.description: Splits a large local change (uncommitted or committed) into a stacked-MR chain. Use when the user asks to split an MR they find too big to review, wants stacked diffs, has sprawling AI-mode work to publish, or types /stack-changes.
